exceptions.api_reachability: Linux build-time procedural macro only; it is not linked as executable runtime code.
exceptions.rationale: The newest compatible Tauri Linux stack still selects GTK3 macros, and this warning reports maintenance status rather than a known vulnerability.
compensating_controls: Cargo.lock and Rust 1.97.1 pin the exact reviewed build graph.
CI compiles and runs tests from source and rejects every dependency or advisory drift.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when the Tauri Linux dependency graph no longer contains proc-macro-error 1.0.4.

exceptions.api_reachability: Linked on Linux through the system WebKitGTK shell; absent from Windows and macOS target graphs.
exceptions.rationale: The newest compatible Tauri and Wry Linux stack still requires the archived GTK3 bindings; this advisory reports maintenance status.
compensating_controls: Capsules cannot load native plugins or dynamically select host GUI libraries.

exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when upstream Tauri/Wry migrates the Linux host away from gtk-rs GTK3.

exceptions.api_reachability: The affected VariantStrIter iterator methods have no caller in this workspace or any other locked registry source.
exceptions.rationale: The Linux shell links glib, but exhaustive source search found no path to the advisory's affected VariantStrIter API.
compensating_controls: Capsules cannot load native plugins or invoke arbitrary host library APIs.
The raw child WebView has no Tauri IPC and reaches only the exact default-deny custom protocol.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when upstream Tauri/Wry selects glib 0.20 or later, or immediately if VariantStrIter becomes reachable.

exceptions.api_reachability: Reachable while Tauri parses bundled capability URL patterns on every desktop target; no vulnerable API is reported.
exceptions.rationale: Current tauri-utils pins urlpattern 0.3; the advisory reports maintenance status and urlpattern 0.6 is not semver-compatible.
compensating_controls: Capability URL patterns are static host-owned JSON and cannot be supplied by a capsule.
The bundled capability grants no remote URL and excludes install and rollback commands.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when tauri-utils moves to urlpattern 0.6 or another maintained Unicode implementation.
